desktop.notes:
• Mini keypad / dial: hold Alt + turn the wheel (a dial) to go to the previous / next photo - in the grid, the viewer, fullscreen, and in compare (moves the highlighted image). The plain wheel still zooms. The wheel over the filmstrip now changes the photo (the big image follows) instead of only sliding the thumbnails.
• Q = compare the photo's burst / similar set (or the selected photos); Q again closes it. (X still works; Q is no longer a second Keep key.) Enter in compare = done, and compare has a ← Back button like Backup.
• I (info): "Burst · 12" and "Similar · 5" tags under the photo's info when it belongs to them - click one to compare that group.
• Albums: put photos together while culling - right-click → Albums → New album… / add / take out / make it the cover; Cull → Albums: show an album's photos, add the selection, Send to Library, Copy to a folder, rename, delete (the photos always stay). An Albums chip in the filter bar; "Search all my folders" finds an album's photos on any drive. Albums travel on the card with your decisions (phone ⇄ PC: renames and deletes too) and go into the Library (albums.json + each photo's .pnfo) for Studio, Wildframe and Wallpaper Studio - a later change made in Studio is never undone by Cullect.
• Send as link (Settings → General): Send to Library can keep only the data (.pnfo) in the Library and point to the original where it is - no copy, no space. Studio / Wildframe open the original from there (or a verified backup); the drive must be connected. A RAW without a JPEG is still copied as a JPEG. Nothing is written next to the original. Sending again with the setting off copies the picture and forgets the link.
• library.json now has the subject and species for every photo (tag groups "Subject" / "Species" were missed).
